**Target:** FY2023 net income margin (net income ÷ revenue) for Salesforce, Inc. (CRM), fiscal year ending 2023‑01‑31.

**Calculation:**
- Net income (FY2023): $208,000,000 (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss) — 10‑K filed 2023‑03‑08, accession 0001108524‑23‑000011
- Revenue (FY2023): $31,352,000,000 (us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax) — same 10‑K, accession 0001108524‑23‑000011
- Margin = 208,000,000 ÷ 31,352,000,000 = 0.006634 → ≈0.663% (net margin)

**Source:** Salesforce, Inc. Form 10‑K for FY2023, accession 0001108524‑23‑000011 (filed 2023‑03‑08), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852423000011/0001108524-23-000011-index.htm. Both inputs matched by independent tool lookup against the frozen evidence.

ANSWER: 0.663% (net income ÷ revenue, FY2023)
